domain: University Course Scheduling and Enrollment Management
scenario:
A university is developing an enterprise-level Course Management System (CMS) designed to streamline the scheduling and enrollment processes for courses offered each semester. The system should manage detailed information about course offerings, including course numbers, sections, descriptions, and enrollment capacities. It should support various academic departments in planning and managing their course schedules while providing real-time updates on enrollment status.

The CMS needs to accommodate complex scheduling needs, such as multiple sections for lectures and labs, and ensure that students can easily enroll in courses with available seats. The system will track both maximum and actual enrollments to help departments optimize resource allocation and identify courses that may require additional sections due to high demand.

Additionally, the platform should provide administrators with tools to analyze enrollment trends and make data-driven decisions for future course offerings. It should also offer features for students to search for courses by term, subject, and other criteria, ensuring a seamless enrollment experience.
